caption: The drawing depicts a single brown ceramic pitcher with a rounded body, a flared pedestal base, a curved pouring spout, and an ornate handle. The body of the pitcher features a lighter brown horizontal band around its middle section, adorned with a painted decorative motif consisting of a white flower with a red center, green leaves, and yellow accents. The rest of the pitcher is shaded in darker brown tones, giving it a sense of three-dimensionality. The drawing is set against a plain, off-white background, and is enclosed within a lightly drawn rectangular border. There is a handwritten signature in the bottom right corner.
title: Small Pitcher
